name: FAIR1M
description: Fine-grained aerial object detection dataset for detecting and classifying objects in high-resolution remote-sensing images, including fine-grained aircraft and ship categories. Dataset files are not vendored.
citation: Sun et al., FAIR1M: A Benchmark Dataset for Fine-grained Object Recognition in High-Resolution Remote Sensing Imagery.

license.notes: Dataset license terms are not clearly specified on the project page; check the upstream terms before use.
